## Purpose
Publish the previously conversation-only ZAK-04 source recovery and function comparison as a **R1-schema documentary sidecar**. This is not code engineering or central VMESTYE acceptance.

## Scope and records
- 20 scoped historical T cases, with source versions, individual old/new transforms, bounded mechanism comparisons and open questions; **not a claim that all applicable historical functions have been discovered**.
- R1 literal headers and identifiers across nine adopted-facing files and four supplements: `FINDINGS.tsv`, `OPERATION_TRACES.tsv`, `AUTHORITY_USE.tsv`, `EVIDENCE.tsv`, `COVERAGE.tsv`, `UNJOINS.tsv`, `MECHANISM_RECONCILIATION.tsv`, `SOURCE_SEARCH_LOG.tsv`, `REVERSE_CONSUMERS.tsv`, `DATA_SHAPES.tsv`; `SCOPE_CONTRACT.md` and one `CASES/` narrative per T.
- 200 declared T×domain cells: 40 FOUND source/module locators, 140 NOT_INSPECTED, 20 SOROK-boundary UNRESOLVED. FOUND is not operational equivalence.
- Original eight ZAK-04 obligation IDs and original R2 15-row ledger retained by stable references; seven-file prior addendum preserved byte-for-byte in `SUPPLEMENT/`.
- G1-A's 28/28 source locators recovered at pinned blobs; 27 original paths, F6M recovered at exact R29 candidate path.
- Located R39 F6P sourcefree consumer and inherited author receipt; identified protected objective-position materializer at later cut. Explicit NEG07/NEG08 holds.

## Evidence boundaries
This return is **S0–S1 read-only reconnaissance** plus attributed historical author receipts, not newly executed tests or scientific acceptance. No selected original35/native production first reader, complete semantic supersession, FF→R05 causal effect, actor issuance, or independent same-HEAD receiving is claimed.

## Safety
Only documentation is added under `UNIFIED_LOG_R1/ZAK04_FIELD_FORGE_TEMPORAL_WORLD_SOROK_R1/`. No test runner, code, CI, protected file, or authority grant changes; **do not merge without independent review**.
